rules.label: Announce advancements
rules.description: Changes announce advancements for this world.

rules.label: In block interaction explosions, some blocks won't drop their loot
rules.description: Some of the drops from blocks destroyed by explosions caused by block interactions are lost in the explosion.

rules.label: Broadcast command block output
rules.description: Changes command block output for this world.

rules.label: Command modification block limit
rules.description: Number of blocks that can be changed at once by one command, such as fill or clone.

rules.label: Disable elytra movement check
rules.description: Changes disable elytra movement check for this world.

rules.label: Disable raids
rules.description: Changes disable raids for this world.

rules.label: Advance time of day
rules.description: Changes do daylight cycle for this world.

rules.label: Drop entity equipment
rules.description: Controls drops from minecarts (including inventories), item frames, boats, etc.

rules.label: Update fire
rules.description: Changes do fire tick for this world.

rules.label: Respawn immediately
rules.description: Changes do immediate respawn for this world.

rules.label: Spawn phantoms
rules.description: Changes do insomnia for this world.

rules.label: Require recipe for crafting
rules.description: If enabled, players will be able to craft only unlocked recipes.

rules.label: Drop mob loot
rules.description: Controls resource drops from mobs, including experience orbs.

rules.label: Spawn mobs
rules.description: Some entities might have separate rules.

rules.label: Spawn pillager patrols
rules.description: Changes do patrol spawning for this world.

rules.label: Drop blocks
rules.description: Controls resource drops from blocks, including experience orbs.

rules.label: Spawn Wandering Traders
rules.description: Changes do trader spawning for this world.

rules.label: Vines spread
rules.description: Controls whether or not the Vines block spreads randomly to adjacent blocks. Does not affect other type of vine blocks such as Weeping Vines, Twisting Vines, etc.

rules.label: Spawn Wardens
rules.description: Changes do warden spawning for this world.

rules.label: Update weather
rules.description: Changes do weather cycle for this world.

rules.label: Deal drowning damage
rules.description: Changes drowning damage for this world.

rules.label: Thrown ender pearls vanish on death
rules.description: Whether ender pearls thrown by a player vanish when that player dies.

rules.label: Deal fall damage
rules.description: Changes fall damage for this world.

rules.label: Deal fire damage
rules.description: Changes fire damage for this world.

rules.label: Forgive dead players
rules.description: Angered neutral mobs stop being angry when the targeted player dies nearby.

rules.label: Deal freeze damage
rules.description: Changes freeze damage for this world.

rules.label: Global sound events
rules.description: When certain game events happen, like a boss spawning, the sound is heard everywhere.

rules.label: Keep inventory after death
rules.description: Changes keep inventory for this world.

rules.label: Lava converts to source
rules.description: When flowing lava is surrounded on two sides by lava sources it converts into a source.

rules.label: Broadcast admin commands
rules.description: Changes log admin commands for this world.

rules.label: Command chain size limit
rules.description: Applies to command block chains and functions.

rules.label: Command context limit
rules.description: Maximum number of contexts that can be used by commands like 'execute as'.

rules.label: Entity cramming threshold
rules.description: Changes max entity cramming for this world.

rules.label: In mob explosions, some blocks won't drop their loot
rules.description: Some of the drops from blocks destroyed by explosions caused by mobs are lost in the explosion.

rules.label: Allow destructive mob actions
rules.description: Changes mob griefing for this world.

rules.label: Regenerate health
rules.description: Changes natural regeneration for this world.

rules.label: Player's Nether portal delay in creative mode
rules.description: Time (in ticks) that a creative mode player needs to stand in a Nether portal before changing dimensions.

rules.label: Player's Nether portal delay in non-creative mode
rules.description: Time (in ticks) that a non-creative mode player needs to stand in a Nether portal before changing dimensions.

rules.label: Sleep percentage
rules.description: The percentage of players who must be sleeping to skip the night.

rules.label: Projectiles can break blocks
rules.description: Controls whether impact projectiles will destroy blocks that are destructible by them.

rules.label: Random tick speed rate
rules.description: Changes random tick speed for this world.

rules.label: Reduce debug info
rules.description: Limits contents of debug screen.

rules.label: Send command feedback
rules.description: Changes send command feedback for this world.

rules.label: Show death messages
rules.description: Changes show death messages for this world.

rules.label: Snow accumulation height
rules.description: When it snows, layers of snow form on the ground up to at most this number of layers.

rules.label: Respawn location radius
rules.description: Changes spawn radius for this world.

rules.label: Allow spectators to generate terrain
rules.description: Changes spectators generate chunks for this world.

rules.label: In TNT explosions, some blocks won't drop their loot
rules.description: Some of the drops from blocks destroyed by explosions caused by TNT are lost in the explosion.

rules.label: Universal anger
rules.description: Angered neutral mobs attack any nearby player, not just the player that angered them. Works best if forgiveDeadPlayers is disabled.

rules.label: Water converts to source
rules.description: When flowing water is surrounded on two sides by water sources it converts into a source.
